entries.credentialInputHint: The key is written to the DSH credential store only — it is never saved in the ledger and never echoed back.
entries.secretMigrationPending: These credentials remain in the local ledger. Export the matching environment variables and restart:
entries.minimaxOriginNote: Empty: official sites. Otherwise the Key is sent only to this origin. Use a trusted address without a path.
entries.codexQuotaEnabled: Show Codex quota (requires a signed-in Codex plugin)
entries.codexQuotaSidebar: Show Codex quota in sidebar (keep the conversation strip when hidden)
entries.codingPlanDisplayNote: “Main sidebar / Both” shows a quota card; the narrow rail shows percentages.
entries.quotaRefreshReady: Enable and save a display position to refresh
entries.quotaSectionNote: Enabled items move to the top; click a name to expand its own settings. Up to 8 custom balances and 4 gateway sources.
entries.codingPlanDisabledNote: Disabled. Enable it to query this vendor's coding plan quota on the refresh interval and show it here.
entries.goQuotaDisabledNote: Enable OpenCode Go rolling 5h, weekly and monthly quotas in the sidebar, Settings and bottom-right corner. Missing subscriptions show a reason.
entries.cornerEnabledLabel: Show OpenCode Go quota / budget at the bottom-right
